description: CARTO Spatial Features v4 for the United States on Quadgrid level 15 cells (~1 km, quadbin index). Every cell carries population and the full age/sex structure (WorldPop), points-of-interest counts by category (Overture Maps), elevation (NASA ASTER GDEM), an urbanity classification, monthly climate normals — temperature, precipitation, solar radiation, wind and vapour pressure (WorldClim) — nighttime lights (VIIRS), cell-tower density (OpenCellID) and CARTO's Human Activity Index. Mirror of the CARTO Data Observatory dataset `derived_spatialfeatures_usa_quadgrid15_v1_yearly_v4` (do_date 2026-01-01, 14,620,678 cells), republished as GeoParquet with the cell polygons from `geography_usa_quadgrid15_v1`. The collection is hive-partitioned by quadkey prefix (`quadkey=*/*.parquet`); read all partitions at once with the `partition:glob` (`gs://carto-do-portolan-catalog-us/spatial-features/usa-quadgrid15/quadkey=*/*.parquet`).
title: Spatial Features v4 — United States (Quadgrid level 15)

styles/default.description: Population per cell, 6 quantile classes of the populated cells plus an uninhabited class; breaks [1.5, 7.5, 40.0, 300.0, 2000.0]; CARTOColors Sunset.
